title: Thai Spring Fritters
description: Crispy and flavorful spring fritters with a sweet Thai twist, perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together chopped spring onions and fritters.
2. Add 1 cup of vibrant vegetable oil to a deep frying pan and heat to 350°F.
3. Dust fritter mixture with British all-purpose flour.
4. Carefully drop tablespoon-sized fritter mixture into the hot oil.
5. Fry for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Remove fritters from oil with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain.
7. Serve fritters hot with quick sweet chili sauce for dipping.
